README.md.text:
# Account lookup

Node runs these modules directly. Run `npm test`, `npm run build`, and
`npm run smoke`; no installation is needed.

`lookupAccount` accepts a string and always returns a promise. An empty trimmed
key is missing. The directory returns an account or null. A TEMP_DOWN failure
becomes unavailable; other failures preserve their error identity. Permission is
checked against current state after retrieval. The full account is returned only
when permitted. Input can come from an untyped host bridge.

`publishReceipt` sends JSON through an acquired lease. Release happens after send
settles and is awaited on success and failure. Consumers observe the send result
or error. The lease cannot be used after release.

README.md.text:
# Account lookup

Node runs these modules directly. Run `npm test`, `npm run build`, and
`npm run smoke`; no installation is needed.

`lookupAccount` accepts a string and always returns a promise. An empty trimmed
key is missing. The directory returns an account or null. A TEMP_DOWN failure
becomes unavailable; other failures preserve their error identity. Permission is
checked against current state after retrieval. The full account is returned only
when permitted. Input can come from an untyped host bridge.

`publishReceipt` sends JSON through an acquired lease. Release happens after send
settles and is awaited on success and failure. Consumers observe the send result
or error. The lease cannot be used after release.
